name: Sika Air - LS
paste:
SIKA® AIR - LS: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® Air - LS, April 2023, Version 01.04 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/f/sika_air_-_ls.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® Air - LS where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.04).
1.2 Product description. Sika® Air-LS is an air-entraining agent based on synthetic surfactants. It is a diluted version of Sika® Air and therefore performs and fulfils the same function as Sika® Air but at higher dose rates, to enable more accurate dosing. Its efficiency is based upon the entrainment into the mix of a high number of correctly sized and evenly distributed air bubbles.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Sika® Air LS is used to.
    - Improve resistance to freeze-thaw cycles in hardened concrete;
    - Increase cohesion, reducing the concrete tendency to bleed and segregate;
    - Improve compaction of low workability mixes including semi-dry concrete.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® Air - LS
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: AEA - Air Entraining Agent
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates. Sika® Air-LS meets and exceeds all requirements of Australian Standard AS 1478.1-2000 for Air-entraining admixture (AEA).
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS 1478.1-2000: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Improves concrete workability;
    - Increases cohesion and reduces the risk of segregation;
    - No effect on setting times;
    - Increased freeze and thaw resistance
    - Reduced bleed water
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Water based liquid orange-brown
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Specific advice: Exact dosage rates of Sika® Air-LS can be determined by air meter tests in trial mixes.
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 205 litre drum; Bulk deliveries
    - Shelf life: In unopened original container 12 months at least
    - Storage conditions: Store at temperature between 5ºC and 35º C protected from direct sunlight and frost

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.04) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.04) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Dispensing: Sika ® Air-LS is added directly to the mixing water
    - Compatibility: Sika® Air - LS is compatible with all the water reducer (WR), mid range water reducer (MWR), high range water reducer (HWR), set accelerator and set retarder manufactered by Sika Australia PTY LTD.
4.3 Recommended dosage. Typical dosage rates for general concrete production range from 250-750 mls per cubic metre of concrete. For low slump concrete (<65 mm slump) and pavement type concrete, particularly concrete that contains high volume of fly ash, substantially higher dose rate of Sika Air LS may be required to achieve the desired air content. Typical dose rates for high volume fly ash or low slump concrete range from 500-3000 ml per cubic metre of concrete.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.04) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® Air - LS, April 2023, Version 01.04, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/f/sika_air_-_ls.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sika Air LS, version 09/04/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/n/MSDS%20Sika%C2%AE%20Air%20-%20LS%20(AU)%20GHS7.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sika® Air - LS, version 03/03/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/a/sds-sika-air-ls.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
